gloss: just a moment ago; just now

definitions.gloss: just a moment ago; only a short while ago
definitions.explanation: つい (just, only) intensifying さっき (a while ago): stresses that very little time has passed, typically minutes rather than hours. Casual, spoken register.

examples.japanese: ついさっき⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: I got back just a moment ago.

examples.japanese: ついさっき⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っていた→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: It was raining until just a moment ago.

examples.japanese: ついさっき⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{用件|ようけん}→用件：15058_youken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: He called only a moment ago, and I've already forgotten what it was about.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- ついさっき⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until just a moment ago
- ついさっき〜たばかり: to have only just done something
- ついさっき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと: something that happened just now

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦さっき→さっき：01264_sakki⟧: a while ago — the plain form, vaguer and possibly an hour or more back
- ⟦たった{今|いま}→たった今：20560_tattaima⟧: this very moment — even more immediate, and usable in writing
- {先|さき}ほど: a short while ago — the polite equivalent, used in business speech

REGISTER:
Conversational. In polite or written contexts, use {先|さき}ほど instead.
